# Select

Native styled exactly like Input (same heights, borders, focus ring) with a chevron.

`KenosUI.Select` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Select />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Select"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Native <select> styled like Input: fast, accessible, works on phones.

## Props (SelectProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"outline" \| "subtle" \| "flushed"` |  |
| `size` | `"2xs" \| "xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "2xl"` | Same heights as Input. Default "md". |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |
| `options` | `Array<string \| { value: string; label: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }>` |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Disabled first option shown while value is "". |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>, "size">._
